answer: The protocol gates agent enrollment by requiring the solution of non-reusable computational puzzles, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest participant. A verifier functions as a digital sparrow, scanning each proof at the geometric vertex of incoming data to detect reused work. Each agent must secure a unique computational oasis by following a spiral path of novel cryptographic challenges that cannot be precomputed or shared between instances. Evidence of replicated work triggers permanent account locking with no refund, enforcing cost-per-identity scarcity.
